conditioning.procedure: from the entry state: N neutral frames (N from the declared ladder, one per start so the histories differ), then the cartridge's declared entry procedure once more, then accept only if the shared phase instrument reports a gameplay phase
conditioning.comparabilityCriterion: the phase instrument (tools/agod_phase_evidence.cjs) reports PASS; where it cannot be computed the state is recorded as NOT-ATTESTED and the arm says so

arms.BASELINE: pristine + a neutral prefix per start, as the pipeline does today
arms.GATE: strategy A: the change must reproduce on every state before induction; otherwise NOT_REPRODUCED_ACROSS_STARTS
arms.REPLAY: strategy B1: every start is the exact saved discovery snapshot - replay reproducibility only, not independent confirmation
arms.HISTORY: strategy B2: each start reached by its own independent history through the declared procedure
